name: Essen Speciality Films Ltd.
summary: Essen Speciality Films Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer and exporter of specialized plastic products, primarily focusing on high-quality plastic films and sheets for various industries. The company specializes in Ethylene Vinyl Acetate (EVA) based products, including bathroom liners, shower curtains, table covers, anti-skid mats, multi-purpose mats, shelf liners, yoga mats, interlocking foam tiles, kids' puzzle mats, artificial plants, and kitchen and dining articles. They emphasize eco-friendly alternatives such as EVA and PEVA, and utilize sustainable materials including Bio-PE, Bio-EVA, and recycled polymers in their production processes. Essen Speciality Films Ltd. serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of its revenue derived from exports to regions like North America, Europe, and Latin America. Its clientele includes major global retailers such as IKEA, Walmart, Kmart, Bed Bath & Beyond, and Kohl's. The company operates within the specialty films and home decor segments, functioning as a niche player in the broader plastics industry by providing customized plastic articles for global furnishing companies.
